verdict.rationale: A live, versioned production REST platform answers at api.service.hmrc.gov.uk with a structured error contract (hmrc-probe-1). A developer hub host exists (hmrc-probe-2), and Making Tax Digital filing is explicitly routed through compatible software (hmrc-docs-10, hmrc-docs-11, hmrc-supp-3), which shows a sanctioned programmatic channel. However, the developer hub's content was never fetched because its robots.txt disallows crawlers, so the documentation itself, its endpoint coverage and its auth/onboarding model are unverified. Missing for 10: evidenced API documentation content, endpoint coverage across tax services (VAT, Corporation Tax, PAYE), documented auth/credential onboarding for a user or agent, independent hands-on corroboration of driving workflows end-to-end via the API.
